questions.question: Jesus told the crowds and His disciples to ignore everything the scribes and Pharisees teach. True or false?
Jesus told the crowds not to do what the scribes and Pharisees, the religious teachers, do. Why not?

answers.text: They do not practice what they preach
They copy the customs of foreigners
They do not keep the Sabbath day

questions.question: Jesus said the scribes and Pharisees do all their deeds for what purpose?

answers.text: So the poor will be fed

questions.question: Jesus told the crowds and His disciples not to be called Rabbi. What reason did He give?

answers.text: They have one Teacher and are all brothers
The title belongs only to the priests
They have not studied long enough yet
